key_insight: An agentic LLM pipeline translated natural-language research requests into multi-stage EHR queries, achieving a median adjusted F1 score of 0.90.
clinical_relevance: The approach could help researchers identify study cohorts across structured records and clinical notes.
method: Decompose investigator requests into source-specific tasks.
Generate and execute SQL queries on EHR data.
Integrate structured and unstructured evidence with study-specific clinical note adjudication.
evidence_signal: Evaluated against analyst-identified cohorts for 50 pediatric orthopedic requests, with 43 in manual-review-adjusted analyses: median PPV 0.93, sensitivity among patients identified by either approach 0.92, and F1 0.90.
watch_item: Sensitivity was measured only among patients identified by either approach, so patients missed by both were not captured by that metric.
paper_title: Agentic Pipeline for Large-Scale Clinical Data Queries in Enterprise Electronic Health Records
